For R 3.3.x and Rtools33 you should be using gcc 4.9.x. Did you do the part of the instructions that says to execute

cat('Sys.setenv(BINPREF = "C:/Rtools/mingw_$(WIN)/bin/")',

    sep = "\n", append = TRUE)

Ben

Hi Daniel,

Sure!  I'm lucky to find that I keep a copy of all the error during the debugging.  

About one month ago, I changed the TEMP and TMP environment variables in User Variables from disk-C to D, but I miswrote the folder path.  It should be D:\USERTemp, but I wrote it as D:USERTemp.  (My computer somehow works well after that!)  

My classmate help me find this problem.  We could find it because when I ran the test stan function twice or more times, it would show the following error: Error in file(file, ifelse(append, "a", "w")) : cannot open the connection In addition: Warning message: In file(file, ifelse(append, "a", "w")) : cannot open file 'D:USERTemp/RtmpUrLY8M/file1a905e30692b.cpp': No such file or directory.  (If I just ran the test function once, it showed error as: Error in compileCode(f, code, language = language, verbose = verbose) : Compilation ERROR, function(s)/method(s) not created!)  It seemed that R cannot find the location of temporary cpp file, hence I changed the folder path, and the problem was settled!

This is how the whole thing goes on.  Hope it can help other users.  Please tell me if any detail unclear.

Best Regards,
Ding
